title: EnforcerMemoryRecord
description: One append-only memory record (NDJSON line). Transitional capture format: flushes to DuckDB, then to the x06 enforcer-memory graph (+ vector index). camelCase wire, mirrors x05 LessonRecord / x06 MemoryNode vocabulary so import is a mapping, not a rewrite.

id.description: Globally unique, writer-scoped: mem-<writer>-<NNNN>. Never reused, never reset.

kind.description: userPref = how the user wants the system to behave; lesson = generalized learning (mirrors x05); decision = a ruling taken (by user or orchestrator) that constrains future work; observation = raw signal from usage (scan result, interaction, request pattern); incident = a fault occurrence (graph t0 evidence).

why.description: Rationale/context — why this is true or wanted.

howToApply.description: Operational instruction for an agent acting on this record.

ref.description: Pointer: commit sha, hub event id, ledger row id (L-number), file path, mail seq.

routes.description: Where this record ships (x05 LessonRoute superset). Every record defaults to graphNode — the x06 import target.

landedAt.description: Durable artifacts this record already landed in (commit sha, doc §, rule id). Empty = pending.

supersedes.description: id of a prior record this replaces (append-only: never edit, supersede).

writer.description: Lane/stream owner: primary, arc-04, d15... ONE writer per stream file — no cross-writer appends.

user.description: Only when kind=userPref/decision originates from the user; redaction policy applies before any export tier.
